title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
original_title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
summary: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.
title_zh: Meta 发布轻量模型 Muse Ember
lead_zh: Meta 发布面向智能体执行的轻量模型 Muse Ember，报道称其输入价格为每百万 token 10 美分，低于 Haiku 和 Luna 等竞品。
